When I get carried away.

title: WE'VE GOT THE  POWER
lyrics:
We've got the power, in the Name of Jesus.
We've got the power, in the Name of the Lord.
Though Satan rages, we shall not be defeated,
We've got the power, in the Name of the Lord

title: THERE  IS NONE LIKE YOU
lyrics:
There is none like you.
No one else can touch my heart like you do.
I could search for all eternity, Lord,
And find, there is none like you.

title: IT’S  JESUS ON THE INSIDE
lyrics:
It’s Jesus on the inside, working towards the
outside,
Making a difference in my life.(repeat)
It’s the Holy Ghost on the inside, working towards the outside,
Making a difference in my life.(repeat) It’s the Word on the inside, working towards
the outside,
Making a difference in my life,(repeat)

title: BE  IT UNTO ME ACCORDING TO THY WORD
lyrics:
Be it unto me according to Thy Word,
According to your promises, I can stand secure.
Carve upon my heart the truth that sets me free,
According to Your Word, O Lord, be it unto me.

You promised Your blood would deliver,
Lord, we believe it’s true.
You promised us joy like a river.
Lord, we receive it from You.
These things You have spoken,
You’re bringing to pass.
This world’s disappearing,
But Your Word will last.

He promised to carry our sorrow,
Lord, we believe it’s true.
You promised unending tomorrows,
Lord, we receive it from You.
You will be our provider,
In your Word it’s revealed,
And by the stripes that you bore,
We have been healed.

title: COME  TO MY SOUL, PRECIOUS JESUS
lyrics:
Come to my soul, precious Jesus, my Lord,
Here me, Oh Saviour Divine.
Open the fountain and cleanse me,
Give me a heart like thine.

title: READY  TO LEAVE
lyrics:
Ready to leave in the twinkling of an eye,
Making investments in the bank up in the sky.
Oh happy preparation, not a reason to grieve,
Are you in that number getting ready to leave.

title: TOUCH  YOUR PEOPLE ONCE AGAIN
lyrics:
We need wisdom, we need power
And true love for each other;
We have had so many big but empty words.
So we come before your face,
Asking for your grace:
Bring your people to a state of kingdom light
Restore your bride again.

CHORUS

Touch your people once again
With your precious holy hand, I pray;
Let your kingdom shine upon this earth,
Through a wondrous glorious bride.
Not for temporary deeds,
But to restore authority and power;
Let a rushing mighty wind blow,
Touch your people once again.

Lord you see the tired servants,
And the broken wounded soldiers;
Oh, how much we need your precious holy hand.
We need the power of the cross
As the only source for us;
When we stand up facing final battle cry:
Restore your bride again.

title: PEACE  LIKE A RIVER
lyrics:
Peace like a river, love like a mountain.
The wind of your spirit
Is blowing everywhere.
Joy like a fountain, Healing stream of life;
Come holy Spirit, let your fire fall.

title: JUST  BEYOND THE VAIL
lyrics:
Just beyond the vail,
I long to see your face;
Just to see your beauty there,
Just beyond the vail.

You’re the Prince of Peace,
you’re the Prince of Peace,
You’re the Prince of Peace, you are,
You’re the Prince of Peace.

Beautiful you are, beautiful you are,
Beautiful you are, you are,
Beautiful you are.

title: OPEN  OUR EYES
lyrics:
Open our eyes, Lord,
We want to see Jesus,
To reach out and touch Him,
And say that we love Him.

Open our ears, Lord
And help us to listen,
Open our eyes, Lord,
We want to see Jesus.

title: I  EXALT THEE
lyrics:
For Thou, Lord art high above all the earth.
Thou art exalted far above all gods.
For Thou, Lord art high above all the earth.
Thou art exalted far above all gods.

I exalt Thee, I exalt Thee,
I exalt Thee, O Lord.
I exalt Thee, I exalt Thee,
I exalt Thee, O Lord.

title: THANK  YOU JESUS
lyrics:
Thank you, Jesus,
For the things that you have done for us.
Though I can’t repay, the love that you have give me,
I thank you, Lord

title: LET  YOUR LIVING WATER….
lyrics:
Let your living water flow over my soul,
Let your Holy Spirit come and take control.
In every situation that has troubled my mind
All my cares and burdens unto you, I roll.

Father, Father, Father. (2X)
Jesus, Jesus, Jesus. (2X)

title: FATHER  MAKE US ONE
lyrics:
Father make us one,
Father make us one.
That the world may know,
Thou has sent Thy Son;
Father make us one.

title: IT’S  POWER
lyrics:
It’s power, power,
It’s purity divine, and Victory over sin.
It’s power, power,
It’s power of the Holy Ghost.

title: THY  WORD
lyrics:
Thy Word is a lamp unto my feet and a light
unto my path. (2X)

When I feel afraid,
Think I’ve lost my way,
Still you’re there right beside me.
And nothing will I fear
As long as you are near.
Please be near me to the end.

I will not forget your love for me.
And yet my hear forever is wandering.
Jesus, be my guide,
and hold me to your side,
And I will love you to the end.

title: I  WORSHIP YOU ALMIGHTY GOD
lyrics:
I worship You, almighty God
There is none like You
I worship You, Oh prince of peace
That is what I want to do
I give You praise, for You are my righteousness
I worship You Almighty God,
There is none like You.

title: THE  STONE’S BEEN ROLLED BACK
lyrics:
Gone, the stone’s been rolled back
Gone, the tomb is empty
Gone, to sit at the Father’s right hand
Gone, over death triumphant
Gone, sin is defeated,
Gone, He lives forevermore.

title: IT’S  IN JESUS
lyrics:
I have found a love that pardons
I have found some stripes that heal
I have found strength for my weakness
I’ve found grace to cover all my sins.

It’s in Jesus, Oh in Jesus
it’s in Jesus, He’s the One
He’s the rock of salvation
He’s the firm foundation
It’s in Jesus, He’s the One.

title: GOING  HOME, I’M GOING HOME
lyrics:
Going home, yes, I’m going home,
And there’s nothing to hold me here.
For I caught a glimpse of my heavenly home
Praise God, I am going home.

title: WHO’S  REPORT DO YOU BELIEVE
lyrics:
Who’s report do you believe
We shall believe the report of the Lord
(Repeat 3X)

For His report says I am healed
His report says I am Sealed
His report says I am free
His report says Victory

title: INTO  THE CHAMBER, BE  FREE
lyrics:
Into the chamber be free Holy Spirit
Speak to me gently, as I close the door
Heavenly Lover, let Thy presence cover
Shekinah unending is all I long for.

title: I  JUST WANT TO BE WHERE YOU ARE
lyrics:
I just want to be where You are
Dwelling daily in Your presence
I don’t want to worship from afar
Draw me near to where You are

I just want to be where You are
In Your dwelling place forever
Take me to the place where You are
‘Cause I just want to be with You.

I want to be where You are,
Dwelling in Your presence
Feasting at Your table
Surrounded by Your Glory
in Your presence,
That’s where I always want to be
I just want to be, I just want to be with You

I just want to be where You are,
To enter boldly in Your presence
I don’t want to worship from afar
Draw me near to where You are.

O my God, You are my strength and my song
And when I’m in Your presence
Though I’m weak you’re always strong

I just want to be where You are
Dwelling daily in Your presence
I don’t want to worship from afar
Draw me near to where You are.

I just want to be where You are
In your dwelling place forever
Take me to the place where You are
‘Cause I just want to be,
I just want to be with You.

title: GOD  WILL MAKE A WAY
lyrics:
Chorus

God will make a way,
Where there seems to be no way.
He works in ways we cannot see,
He will make a way for me.
He will be my guide,
hold me closely to His side.
With love and strength for each new day,
He will make a way, he will make a way.

By a river in the wilderness He’ll lead me.
Rivers in the desert will I see.
Heaven and earth will fade,
But His love will still remain.
And He will do something new today.

title: WE  ARE STANDING ON HOLY GROUND
lyrics:
We are standing on holy ground
And I know that there are angels all around
Let us praise Jesus now
For we are standing in His presence
On holy ground.

title: YOUR  STEADFAST LOVE
lyrics:
Your steadfast love extends to the heaven
Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds
Your righteousness is like majestic mountains
And Your wisdom like the depths of the sea
And you come to me.

Filling my hear with Your loving kindness
I find my strength in the shadow of your wings.
I eat my fill from the abundance of Your household
And I drink from the stream of rejoicing
You are my king, You are my king.

title: CONSUME  ME LORD
lyrics:
Consume me Lord, with the fire of Your Spirit.
Consume me Lord, and make me more like you.
Break me Lord, and bless the broken pieces of my life
Let me be used, Lord by you.

title: SHINE  JESUS SHINE
lyrics:
Shine Jesus shine
Fill this land with the Father’s glory
Blaze, Spirit, blaze, set our hearts on fire
Flow river flow, flood the nations with grace and mercy
Send forth Your Word, Lord and let there be light.

title: JESUS  YOU’RE THE CENTRE OF MY JOY
lyrics:
Jesus, You’re the center of my joy.
All that’s good and perfect comes from You
You’re the home of my salvation, over all I do.
Jesus, You’re the center of my joy.

title: THINK  ABOUT HIS LOVE
lyrics:
Think about His love, think about His goodness.
Think about His love that’s brought us through.
It’s as high as the heavens above.
So great is the measure of our Father’s love.
Great is the measure of our Father’s love.

title: JESUS  IS REAL TO ME
lyrics:
He’s real, He’s real, Jesus is real to me
Oh yes, He gives me the victory
So many people doubt Him,
I can’t live without Him
That’s why I love Him so, He’s so real to me.

title: WE  ARE ONE BODY
lyrics:
Chorus

Though we are many, we are one body
We are one body in Christ
(Repeat 2X)
One faith in the Lord Jesus Christ
Binding us together in one cause
One hope in the one god
One Father over all

title: PEACE
lyrics:
I will worship the Lord for He is worthy
I will lay down my sword,
the Prince of Peace is His name
King of the flood the Lord is mighty
The Lord can quench the evil flame

Chorus

Peace when trouble blows
Jehovah sees, Jehovah knows
Gives me peace when sorrow nears
Jehovah sees, Jehovah hears
Like the breath I need to live
Jehovah takes, Jehovah gives
Gives me peace when trouble blows
Jehovah sees Jehovah knows
Yes, He knows

title: OH  HOW GOOD IT IS FOR BROTHERS
lyrics:
Oh, how good, how pleasant it is
For brothers to live together in unity
Oh how good is the blessing God gives
When we worship Him together in unity

title: I  PLEDGE ALLEGIANCE
lyrics:
Chorus

I pledge allegiance to the Lamb
With all my strength, with all I am
I will seek to honour His command
I pledge allegiance to the Lamb.

I have heard how Christians long ago
Were brought before a tyrants throne
They were told that he would spare their lives
If they would renounce the name of Christ
But one by one, they chose to die,
The Son of God they would not deny.
Like a great angelic choir sings,
I can almost hear their voices ring

Now the years have come and the years have gone
But the cause of Jesus still goes on
Now our time has come to count the cost
To reject this world to embrace the cross
So, one by one, let us live our lives
For the One who died to give us life
‘Till the trumpet sounds on that final day
Let us proudly stand and boldly say….
To the Lamb of God who bore my shame
Who took my place and bore m pain
I will seek to honour His command
I pledge allegiance to the Lamb.

title: HE’S  MY LORD
lyrics:
He’s my Lord, there is no other
Who can calm the troubled sea
Like my Lord
Giving rest to the weary
Give new life to the hopeless
There’s no doubt about it,
He’s my Lord.

title: HE’S  STILL WORKING ON ME
lyrics:
He’s still working on me
To make me what I ought to be
It took Him just a week to make the moon and the stars
The sun and the earth, Jupiter and mars
How loving and patient He must be
He’s still working on me.

title: I  AM CRUCIFIED WITH CHRIST
lyrics:
I am crucified with Christ,
Never the less I live.
Yet not I, but Christ liveth in me.
And the life that I now live in flesh
I live by the faith of the Son of God,
Who loved me, and gave Himself for me.

title: I  CLAIM THE BLOOD
lyrics:
Chorus

I claim the blood Jesus shed on Calvary
Those precious blood stains
were made there just for me
For all my sins, my sickness and my pain
When I need healing,
I claim those precious blood stains

I have a source of strength when I am weak
That takes me through when life is pressing me
I have a source of power from above
I’m covered over by a shield of blood

I do not know how others make it through
Who never go to Calvary as I do
For there’s a healing, cleansing stream which flows
With peace that only His redeemed can know.

title: I  LOVE TO LOVE YOU
lyrics:
I love to love You, Oh Lord my God
I love to love You, Oh Lord my God
I love to love You, Oh Lord my God
When I come to seek Your face,
I find mercy and grace.

title: I  FEEL THE PULL
lyrics:
I feel the pull, I hear the call
And God’s spirits moving me
To give my all.
He speaks to me, and I agree.
Lord please come and take control,
I feel the pull.

title: I  WANT TO BE A LIVING BIBLE
lyrics:
Chorus

I want to be a living Bible
I want to walk it every day
For I know that when I live the Bible
I’m walking the straight and narrow way

There’s many folks who don’t believe the Bible
I want to tell them all right now I do
Cause the Bible is the Word of God that’s been sent
To give us faith to rapture me and you.

I tell you friend I’ve learned to love my Bible
It’s been the thing that’s kept me all these years
And I know that when I look into it’s pages
I’ll never have a single thing to fear.

I urge you all to go and read your Bible
It’s the only thing that’s worthy of your time
And as you pray to God for revelation
I know that you will put on Jesus Christ.

title: WE  EXALT THEE
lyrics:
We exalt Thee, we exalt Thee
We exalt Thee, Oh Lord
We exalt Thee, we exalt Thee
We exalt Thee, Oh Lord

title: BOUNDLESS  LOVE
lyrics:
We rejoice we rejoice in the name of the Lord
We rejoice in His love today
By His love we can conquer and do anything
We rejoice in His love today

Boundless love, boundless love
He has conquered all of death and the grave
Boundless love, boundless love
By His love our souls are saved

title: SING  UNTO THE LORD A NEW SONG
lyrics:
Sing unto the Lord a new song.
Sing unto the Lord all the earth.
Oh sing unto the Lord a new song,
For He is worthy to be praised.

Come before His presence with Thanksgiving
Enter His courts with praise
Be thankful unto Him and bless His Holy name
For He is worthy to be praised

Lift up holy hands and praise the Lord
Giving thanks unto the Lord
He’s worthy of all honour and praise

title: DRAW  ME CLOSER
lyrics:
Draw me closer Lord,
Draw me closer Lord,
So that I might touch You
So that I might touch You
Lord I want to touch You.

Touch my eyes, Lord,
Touch my eyes, dear Lord,
So that I might see You
So that I might see You
Lord I want to see You.

title: THE  SPIRIT SONG
lyrics:
Chorus

Jesus, Oh Jesus, come and fill Your lambs
Jesus, Oh Jesus, come and fill your lambs.

Oh let the Son of God enfold you
With His Spirit and His love
Let Him fill your heart and satisfy your soul
Oh let Him have the things that hold you
And His Spirit like a dove
Will descend upon your life and make you whole.

Oh let His Word come now and mould you
As you yield your heart to Him
Give yourself in sweet surrender to His will
Oh look each day for His appearing
Let not your eyes of faith grow dim
For He’s coming soon His promise to fulfill.

title: SURELY  THE PRESENCE OF THE LORD
lyrics:
Surely the presence of the Lord is in this place
I can feel His mighty power and grace
I can hear the brush of angels wings
I see glory on each face
Surely the presence of the Lord is in this place.

title: SING  UNTO THE LORD A NEW SONG
lyrics:
Sing unto the Lord a new song
Sing unto the Lord of the earth
Sing unto the Lord a new song
Sing unto the Lord of the Earth
Sing hallelujah …

title: OH  IT IS JESUS
lyrics:
Oh it is Jesus, Yes it is Jesus
It is Jesus in my soul
For I have touched the hem of His garment
And His blood has made me whole.

title: I  KEEP COMING BACK TO THE WELL
lyrics:
Blessed is the fountain in a barren land
That satisfies the thirst of the inner man
No better place can be found to dwell
Oh, won’t you come to the well

Chorus

I keep coming back to the well of grace
Great is the power, sweet is the taste
Whenever temptations and trials I face
I keep coming back to the well

Jesus made a well at Calvary
For healing, cleansing and victory
How it’s joy overflows, no tongue can tell
I thank God for the well.

title: YOU  ARE WORTHY OF THE PRAISE
lyrics:
I lift my voice in praise to You
For you are beautiful
I lift my hands, my heart, my soul
For You are worthy of the praise

I sing this song, to You Oh Lord
It’s all I have to give
And worship You, with all my might
You are worthy of the praise

Lord you, You are worthy of the praise
And we, Lord we worship
Your holy name

title: THE  BLOOD WILL NEVER LOSE ITS POWER
lyrics:
The blood that Jesus shed for me
Way back on dark Calvary
The blood that gives me strength
From day to day, it will never lose it’s power

Chorus

For it reaches to the highest mountain
And it flows to the lowest valley
The blood that gives me strength
from day to day
It will never lose its power

It soothes my doubts and it calms my fears
And it dries, it dries every tear
The blood that gives me strength
From day to day, it will never lose it’s power.

title: I  WILL BLESS THE LORD AT ALL TIMES
lyrics:
I will bless the Lord at all times
I will bless the Lord at all times
His praise shall continually be in my mouth
(Repeat 3X)

title: LORD  MOST HIGH
lyrics:
Lord most high, Lord most high
You are the King of Glory,
Forever pure and holy
Lord, most high.

Hallelujah, hallelujah,
We come before your throne
To worship You alone
Lord, most high.

title: I’VE  NEVER BEEN THIS HOMESICK
lyrics:
See the bright lights shine,
It’s just about home time
I can see my Father standing at the door
This world is but a wilderness
And I’m ready for deliverance
Lord, I’ve never been this home sick before.

title: WON’T  WE HAVE A TIME
lyrics:
Won’t we have a time,
When we get over yonder (Repeat 3X)
Oh, won’t we have a time

We’ll sing and shout and dance about …
King Jesus will be there …
We’ll have no sorrow there …

title: IT’S  KEEPING ME ALIVE
lyrics:
It’s the Holy Ghost and fire
and it’s keeping me alive
Keeping me alive, keeping me alive
It’s the Holy Ghost and fire
and it’s keeping me alive
Jesus is keeping me alive.

title: WERE  YOU THERE
lyrics:
Were you there when they crucified my Lord
Were you there when they crucified my Lord
Oh, sometimes it causes me to tremble, tremble
Were you there when they crucified my Lord

Were you there when they nailed Him
to the tree …
Were you there when He rose up
from the grave …

title: THE  HILLS OF HOME
lyrics:
This house of clay is but a prison
Bars of bone, hold my soul
But the doors of flesh
Are gonna burst wide open
When the hills of home start calling me
I’ll take my flight like a mighty eagle
When the hills of home start calling me.

title: KING  OF KINGS & LORD OF LORDS
lyrics:
King of kings and Lord of lords
Glory, hallelujah
King of kings and Lord of lords
Glory, hallelujah

Jesus, prince of peace
Glory, hallelujah
Jesus, prince of peace
Glory, hallelujah

title: OH  LORD, YOU’RE BEAUTIFUL
lyrics:
Oh Lord, you’re beautiful
Your face is all I seek
For when Your eyes are on this child
Your grace abounds in me.

I want to take your word and shine it all around
But first help me just believe it, Lord
And when I’m doing well
Help me to never seek a crown
For my reward is giving glory to You.

Oh lord, please light the fire
That once burned bright and clear
Renew the lamp of my first love
That burned with Holy fear.

/End of Content Wrapper
/End of Footer

title: IN  THE BLOOD OF CHRIST MY LORD
lyrics:
In the blood of Christ my Lord (3X)
We have the victory
We have the victory, we have the victory
In the blood of Christ my Lord
We have the victory.

title: WE  ARE MARCHING OVER TO JERUSALEM
lyrics:
We are marching over to Jerusalem
We are marching over to Jerusalem
Jerusalem, Jerusalem
Jerusalem, Jerusalem

title: IF  I PERISH
lyrics:
If I perish, I perish but I’m going to see the King
If I perish, I perish but I’m going to see the King
Through dark trials, tribulation, persecution,
I’ll be faithful
But I’m going home to see the King
(Repeat)

If my father won’t go
Mother won’t go,
Brother won’t go, Sister won’t go
I’m going to see the King
(Repeat)

title: BURN,  BURN, HOLY SPIRIT
lyrics:
Burn, burn, Holy Spirit, burn in me
Set my soul on fire
Fill me with the Holy Ghost and God’s full desire
Make me like the Christ of old
Healing and raising the dead
Give me the power that Jesus had
Through the blood that was shed.

title: WE’RE  GOING DOWN THE VALLEY
lyrics:
We’re going down the valley, Up the mountain
Jerusalem is my home
We’re going down the valley, Up the mountain
Jerusalem is my home

It’s my home, sweet home,
Jerusalem is my home.
It’s my home, sweet home,
Jerusalem is my home.

title: AS  WE GATHER
lyrics:
As we gather may your spirit work within us
As we gather may we glorify your name
Knowing that as our hearts begin to worship
We’ll be blessed because we came (2X)

The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases
His mercies never come to an end
They are new every morning new every morning
Great is thy faithfulness, Oh Lord
Great is Thy faithfulness.

title: COME  AND FILL US  NOW
lyrics:
We have come into your presence Lord
Come and fill us now
We have come into your presence Lord
Come and fill us now
With hands lifted up
We open up our hearts to you Lord
And with our hearts lifted up
We glorify Your name
We have come into your presence Lord
Come and fill us now

title: BY  HIS GRACE I AM REDEEMED
lyrics:
By His grace I am redeemed.
By His Blood I am made clean,
And I now can know Him face to face.

By His power I have been raised,
hidden now in Christ by faith.
I will praise the glory of His grace.

title: LORD  I WORSHIP YOU ALONE
lyrics:
All heaven declares the Glory of the risen Lord
Who can compare with the beauty of the Lord
Forever He will be the Lamb upon the Throne
And I’ll gladly bend my knee,
To worship You alone.

I will proclaim the Glory of the risen Lamb,
Who once was slain to reconcile man to God.
Forever You will be the Lamb upon the throne
And I’ll gladly bend my knee,
To worship You alone.

title: BLESSED  BE THE LORD GOD ALMIGHTY
lyrics:
Father in heaven we love You.
We lift Your name in all the earth.
May your kingdom be established in our praises.
As your people declare your mighty word.

Blessed be the Lord God Almighty,
Who was, and is, and is to come.
Blessed be the Lord God almighty,
Who lives forevermore.

title: LORD  I WANT TO LOVE YOU MORE
lyrics:
Lord I want to love You more
Than I ever have before.
You’re so easy to adore
Lord, I want to love You more.

title: FOREVER YOU WILL BE
lyrics:
All heaven declares the glory of the risen Lord,
Who can compare with the beauty of the Lord?

CHORUS
Forever You will be,
The Lamb who died for me,
And I’ll gladly bend my knees,
To worship You alone.

I will proclaim the glory of the risen Lamb
Who once was slain to reconcile man to God.

title: THE HEAVENS DO RULE
lyrics:
Oh, the depth of the knowledge
And the wisdom of the Lord!
His judgements are unsearchable,
And His ways past finding out;
Who hath directed His Spirit?
And whose counsel did He take?
For by Him and through Him
Are all things on earth made.

CHORUS

And we know that all things work together for our good,
The footsteps of the righteous are ordered by the Lord;
Even though things don’t work out
The way we think they should,
Yet we know in all things,
That the heavens surely rule.

Which of us by taking thought could add to ourselves?
Why do we yet so many times resist His will?
We’ve got to realize salvation is wholly of the Lord;
Just stand still and consider
All the wondrous works of God.

There is nothing that happens without a real intent,
Our experiences were ordained,
Our trials have been sent
That we might manifest the purpose
Unto which we have been called,
So in perfect confidence
We can submit to Him our all.

title: THANK YOU FOR THE RAIN
lyrics:
For twenty-three years we have been looking
For God to send the revival amongst us;
Wednesday the 3rd of June we received our inheritance claim;
Now we know the New Name
And we are not hollering again,
and again, and again And again.

CHORUS

Thank You Lord for sending the rain, (Hallelujah) 2x
We thank you again and again,
And again and again and again,
We thank You.

All false branches must be cut off,
For the tree must be pruned and cleaned,
For it’s the Holy Spirit that is planting the life within us
Because He knows that we are the Bride, are the Bride, are the
Bride, are the Bride.

Many families, they were attached to this Word
But they were under man’s teaching;
When our shepherd waved the wave-sheaf over them,
Then they realized they are not shuck, but they are seed, they are seed, they are seed, they are seed.

title: I LOVE HIM
lyrics:
I love Him, I love Him,
Because He first loved me,
And purchased my salvation on
Calvary’s tree.

title: TURN ON THE LIGHT
lyrics:
A people that once sat in darkness saw a marvelous light,
The light of God’s revealed Word flashed across our hearts
And we have been made whole.
Now we walk in the light as He is in the light,
Having fellowship one with the other,
God’s blood that cleanses and
His love that conquers.

CHORUS

There’s a man here that can turn on the light,
There’s a man here that can turn on the light,
So If you’re in darkness, cannot find your way,
There’s a man here that can show you the way.

In the beginning was the Word and the Word was with God,
And the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us,
The light of God’s revealed Word
Face to face we see now,
Almighty God unveiled before us,
The Lamb that was slain, who took the Book
And showed us our names.

King Theophany Jesus that is walking in and amongst us,
God En Morphe for the final turn at the west.
So when you look, what do you see now?
It depends on what you’re looking for,
We are a people that have been set free,
Living epistles that can show you the door.

title: PAST THE CURTAIN OF TIME
A GIFT OF GRACE
lyrics:
A Gift of Grace was all it took
To redeem me again back to His own;
I’ve been redeemed, He saved my soul,
My Saviour paid the price,
Now I’m no more my own.

CHORUS

So seek on Saints,
Seek till you’re filled with power;
Seek on saints
Till His Spirit in you is endowed,
It’s been revealed,
This is the final hour;
And soon His Bride, His Chosen
One
Will go on home.

Unmerited the favour that He granted me
To bring me home today, His very
Own;
’Twas love, ’twas Grace
That stooped so low to conquer me;
My Sovereign Lord gave
Sovereign Grace
To redeem me.

And now I’m home, His robe’s wrapped around me;
This land is mine, this Promise is for me.
Amazing grace, amazing love
Christ poured on me,
His Word went with a promise,
One day we shall meet.

title: I WILL PRAISE THE LORD
lyrics:
I will praise the Lord,
I will praise the Lord,
No matter what tomorrow brings,
What it has in store,
I will praise the Lord.

title: PRAISE YE THE LORD
lyrics:
Praise ye the Lord all ye people!
Praise Him for His goodness,
His majesty and power;
For His merciful kindness is great towards us,
And His righteousness endureth forever.

CHORUS

He’s the Lord of creation,
He’s the Rock of our salvation,
He paid the price for our redemption,
And He is worthy, (so worthy)
He is our comfort in times of sorrow,
Our strength to face tomorrow,
Our refuge in times of trouble,
And He alone is worthy to be praised.

Give thanks unto Him and serve
Him,
For He forgiveth all thy sins,
And healeth all thy diseases,
Who redeemeth you from a life of destruction,
And crowneth you with loving kindness and tender mercies.

BRIDGE

We have so much to praise and thank Him for,
Our lives are testimonies
And so many great things He has done.
Forget not His love and His promises,
For He has promised a new
Heaven,
A new Earth and a new Body.
Praise Him, praise Him,
For He alone is worthy to be praised,
Praise Him, praise Him,
For He alone is worthy to be praised,
So all you got to do is praise
Him, praise Him.
For He alone is worthy to be praised,
Praise Him, praise Him.
For He alone is worthy to be praised,
For He alone is worthy to be praised.

title: PEACE! PEACE!
lyrics:
Peace! peace! wonderful peace,
Coming down from the Father above;
Sweep over my spirit forever, I pray,
In the fathomless billows of love.

title: PARENTAL CARE
lyrics:
You loved me when I was so unlovable
You died for me when I wasn’t worth dying for
You taught me real Godliness; is with contentment
And that my trials only come to bring me patience

Truly your ways is not like our ways
And your thoughts like our thoughts
Yet you chip and you mold me to
Bring me into your image

CHORUS

Truly your love is not parental care for a baby
But your love truly is elective love
You may cause me to suffer like Job
Or to be delivered unto to death like
Paul
But yet in the midst of the all you’re just
Proving how much you really,
really, really
Love me

You taught me when I’m weak, that
I’m strong
And the only way up is down
In order to live in your presence, I must die
Your love is simply amazing who could deny

BRIDGE

Whosoever the Lord loveth, He chasteneth
And if we are without chastisement
We are not of His.
Now no chastisement for the present
Seemeth joyous but then it brings forth the peaceable fruits of righteousness

title: WE ARE STANDING
lyrics:
When I walked through the door
I felt His presence
And I know this is the place
Where love abounds;
And this is the temple, Jehovah
God abides,
And we are standing in His presence
On Holy ground.

CHORUS

We are standing on holy ground
And I know that there are Angels all around;
Let us praise Jesus now,
For we are standing in His presence
On Holy ground.

In His presence,
There is joy beyond all measure;
At His feet, peace of mind can still be found,
So if you have a need,
I know He has the answer,
So reach out and touch Him,
For we are standing on holy ground.

title: THIS IS HOLY GROUND
lyrics:
This is holy ground,
We’re standing on holy round,
For the Lord is here;
And where He is, is holy. 2x

These are holy hands,
We’re lifting up holy hands,
For the Lord is here
And where He is, is holy.
These are holy hands,
We’re lifting up holy hands,
For the Lord is here
And where He is, is holy.

title: ARISE AND POSSESS
lyrics:
CHORUS

Arise, possess your inheritance,
For this is the year of jubilee,
Arise, be not entangled with the yoke of bondage.
Understand the liberty by which
Christ set you free.

Entangled with heavy chains of captivity,
Bruised and battered by sin,
Condemned and sentenced to a life of bondage,
O God, there was no peace within.
Then a sound was heard,
It was like the abundance of rain,
Saying “Rejoice, you have received the atonement,
Accept the pardoning word which was provided for you,
Because you’re not of the bondwoman,
You’re of the free.”

Aren’t you tired of living underprivileged?
Saints, don’t you, don’t you hear that sound?
Saying freedom to the captives,
Restoration to the blind,
Setting free those who are bruised.
Saints, empty your vessels,
Let Him fill them with oil,
You are free, you are free, you are free.
So when the creditor comes to take away your land,
Show him your account
Settled long ago by Calvary’s
Lamb,
And say, “I am free, I am free, I am free.”

Now I can tell the world that I’m free,
I have heard the trumpet sound
Jubilee; Freedom from all burdens and sin,
The Comforter has given me peace within.
///And whom the Son has set free, is free indeed.///

title: GOING HOME
lyrics:
CHORUS

I’m going home in the morning,
I’m going home, it won’t be long,
I’m going home, it won’t be long.

Can’t afford to get my line tangled in these kind of times,
So I’m looking nine times before
I make one step,
Don’t want to be caught
In an unconscious state of mind,
For I want to leave this earth
In the twinkling of an eye.

I’m going to slip from time into eternity,
I’m going to become one with my
Theophany,
Going to live in that mansion
God has prepared for me,
I’m going to leave this pest-house for eternity.

We’re going to be reunited with our loved ones
Who have gone on before to another dimension;
Soon we’ll see Him face to face,
The One who lives inside our hearts;
Who saved us by His amazing grace,
We’ll be with Him never to depart.

Could it be between six or nine?
Whatever the time
I want to be ready to meet my
Bridegroom.

title: THIS  THE YEAR OF JUBILEE
lyrics:
This is the year of Jubilee,
This is the year of Jubilee,
When all the captives are set free
Come ye halt, ye blind, ye lame,
Leap and shout for joy again,
This is the year of Jubilee.......

title: I’LL FLY AWAY
lyrics:
Some glad morning when this life is over,
I’ll fly away,
To a home on God’s celestial shore
I’ll fly away.

CHORUS

I’ll fly away, O, glory! I’ll fly away
When I die, hallelujah! by and by,
I’ll fly away.

When the shadows of this life have grown,
I’ll fly away;
Like a bird from prison bars has flown,
I’ll fly away.

Just a few more weary days and then,
I’ll fly away;
To a land where joys shall never end,
I’ll fly away.

title: PART OF HIS BRIDE
lyrics:
He leads me through troubled waters,
He holds my hands through darkest sky;
He comforts me when my heart is laden down with grief,
He’s coming back to take me away as His bride.

CHORUS

For I’m His bride, I’m His only loved one,
I’m His chosen, His fair one, His dove;
For I was predestined,
In His grace, I now abide.
What an honour, oh, how marvelous, what a privilege,
Thank You Jesus, I’m part of Your bride.

Before the world, He knew me in glory,
Before the sun, I lived and reigned with Him;
Now my soul longs to see Him,
On the clouds that He rides,
Coming back to rapture me as His bride.

title: HOLY SPIRIT
lyrics:
Holy Spirit, Thou art welcome in this place,
Holy Spirit, Thou art welcome in this place,
Omnipotent Father of mercy and
Grace
Thou art welcome in this place.

title: WE ARE LIKE SHIPS
lyrics:
CHORUS

We are like ships sailing across life's troubled sea,
But with our compass set on the
North Star
We'll reach the shores of
Eternity,
We are like ships sailing across life's troubled sea,
But with our compass set on the
North Star
We'll reach the shores of
Eternity.

Contrary winds of doctrine blew against us on the way,
But we set our eye on the Captain,
Listened to what He had to say.
Many ships were tossed to and fro ad were driven off their course,
But we are thankful to our Captain,
We aren't shipwrecked, we aren't lost.
He said, “Peace be still.”
To see the glory of the Lord you must stand still. 2x

We are sailing through many rough waters,
Using our paddles skillfully,
Now we are faced with treacherous conditions,
We need the Master of the sea
To say "Peace be still."
To see your troubles end, you must stand still;
He’ll say, “Peace be still.”
To see the glory of the Lord you must stand still.

Upon the distant shore, there’s a land that’s shining bright;
Soon we'll reach that golden shore
And be welcomed by the Prince of
Light.
He'll say, “Peace be still,
My light has led you to do My perfect will.”
He'll say, “Peace be still,"
And when we see Him face to face
We must stand still.

title: THE BRIDGE TO HEAVEN
lyrics:
Left the splendour of His throne,
Came down to earth,
Had one purpose in His mind.
Tempted in all points as we are
Yet without sin,
Most worthy High Priest,
He's the Supreme Sacrifice.

CHORUS

He is the bridge from Earth to
Heaven, 2x
We now live in God's presence forever.

I'll always look to Calvary where
Redemption price was paid for me,
There on the cross, crucified with
Him.
There on the cross I was in Him,
There on the cross I paid for my sin,
And His glory, I now boldly enter in.

Lift your eyes to Calvary, see where He has set you free,
Loosed from the grips of sin and shame.
Sin has no more dominion over you,
You’re ordained to do just what you do,
He’s that bridge to Heaven for me and you.

To the splendour of His throne,
His Bride now leaves the Earth,
Quickening power now breaks the hold of time;
Travelling faster than the speed of light,
We'll be changed in the twinkling of an eye,
And that bridge to Heaven will be no more.

title: I'M GLAD HE SET ME FREE
lyrics:
I’m so glad Jesus set me free,3x
Glory, hallelujah, Jesus set me free.
(I’m so glad Jesus lifted me...)
(I’m on my way to Heaven,
shouting victory...)

title: ALLELUJAH
lyrics:
We are the children of God,
Chosen vessels unto Him;
Our angels behold the Father’s face
We are special unto Him.
We should never be ashamed
To testify of our love for Him,
For we are privileged
To be the children of the KING of
KINGS!

CHORUS

Al-le-lu-jah!
Glory and praise to the
Saviour;
Al-le-lu-jah!
Let’s worship our King together. 2x

We must dwell in unity
So we’re showing our love to Him,
Having a blameless testimony
A life that’s holy and free from sin;
We should be an example
To the lost who know not the way:
We’re not children of the night but of the day,
So let us show them the way.

With the joy of the Lord
And the strength of our youth,
Let’s be zealous to do God’s will;
Fleeing youthful lusts and pressing to be
Empty vessels that God can fill.
We should never lean to our own understanding,
Casting our reasoning down,
So we’ll be better able to love and serve Him.

title: THIRST
lyrics:
As we set our faces towards
Jerusalem,
Knowing that very soon the squeeze will come,
As the day draws nearer, as the day draws closer,
There’s such a painful desire to be like our Saviour.

CHORUS

Oh Jesus, my Lord Jesus,
Only You, only You
Can quench this thirst in my soul. 2x

Many nights I can’t sleep, everyday my soul groans in me,
Waiting for the redemption of this body;
No matter what the world may say,
No matter what the world may do,
It’s a fact that I can’t rest until I’m perfect.

Before the Masterpiece could speak it must be smitten
By the determinate counsel of our
God,
What shall I say then, ‘Father take this cup from me?’
But nevertheless not my will but
Thine be done.

Signs of the time quickly approaching,
We can see the whole creation is groaning;
But, for this purpose came we into this world;
To fulfill what is written of us.

title: MORE THAN EVER BEFORE
lyrics:
More than ever before,
Lord, I love You,
More than ever before,
Lord, I need You,
More than ever before,
I want to serve You;
I love You now,
More than ever before.

title: WHAT WILL YOU PRESENT?
lyrics:
I want to present the life of Christ,
It’s my aim today,
For in His image I want to stand
So blameless on that day;
And though this world may criticize,
It will never understand,
That I can’t rest until I be
A perfect man.

CHORUS

What are you going to present to the Lord
At the end of your journey?
He’s not going to be touched by anything
Save His testimony.
What are you going to present to the
Lord?
I hope it makes you sigh and cry,
Don’t be found in that position
Where you would be wondering why.

Though the world may offer its pleasure and peace,
And its luxurious life of ease,
But it simply cannot continue on
For man’s just like a breeze;
A moment here and a moment gone,
Like a flower he fades away,
But I just want to stay right on
To that perfect day.

Take rest my soul, in no other arms
Save Jesus own today
For He has opened my eyes to see
That judgement is on its way;
And though ten thousand fall at my side
I will never be tossed aside;
For in the shadow of that mighty rock is where I’ll abide.

Lord take Thy Word, Thy precious
Word,
And anoint it to my soul;
Perfect what is lacking in my faith
And make thy servant whole.

For I just want to hear You say,
“Receive thy crown my beloved son
You have overcome, well done!”

title: JESUS WILL TAKE CARE
lyrics:
Have you ever been so distressed
When you see your circumstances look so gloomy,
And the tears begin to cover your eyes?
Remember Jesus will take care of you.

CHORUS

He’s the Rock of all the ages,
He’s the light in the darkest night,
A comfort when there’s no one left to care;
So you don’t look at your circumstances,
They will only bring you down,
Remember Jesus will take care of you.

When you feel so weak and can’t go on;
And the devil, he tempts you so sore;
But if you only call upon Jesus,
He will answer,
For He knows that you’re weak on your own.

title: MANY WATERS
lyrics:
There are so many people in the world today
Don’t really know what true love is;
Many have searched the whole wide world
And still can’t seem to find it.
Love is patient, love is kind,
True love can never be broken;
Love beareth all things,
Love suffers long.
Love is God and God is love,
Who is our King;
But how can you know true love
Without knowing Him?

CHORUS

Many waters cannot quench love,
Neither can the floods drown it, 3x
Whosoever God joins together,
Let no man put asunder.

Therefore shall a man leave father and mother
And cleave unto his wife,
Then they shall be no more twain
But they shall be one.
Then he’ll love his bride as Christ the church,
Who giveth Himself for it;
For no man yet hateth his flesh,
But loveth and cherisheth it.
Love is God and God is love,
Who is our King;
So how can you know true love
Without knowing Him?

title: WE ARE CHILDREN
lyrics:
We are children of the Father,
We are joint-heirs with the Son,
We are people of His Kingdom,
We are family, we are one.

title: RUN WITH THE MESSAGE
lyrics:
There are people all over the world,
To whom this Message must be told;
All those honest in heart,
In this light they have a part.

CHORUS

You’ve got to run, run, run, run,
Run with the Message of
Malachi 4,
You’ve got to tell it like you’ve never told it before;
Let him that readeth run,
Let him that heareth run,
For this Message is the coming of the Lord.

Always ready to give a reason,
Be instant in and out of season,
Willing to take this blessed hope
To a lost and dying world.

Seeing we have this ministry,
Let’s not faint but earnestly
Seek to build the kingdom of
God,
For the glory of the Lord.

title: HEAVEN  IS SWEETER
lyrics:
Heaven's sounding sweeter all the time,
Seems like lately I can’t get it off my mind,
Someday I’m going to leave this world behind.
Heaven's sounding sweeter all the time.

title: HIS WORD IS WORKING
lyrics:
His Word is working mightily in me
His Word is working mightily in me
No matter what the circumstance;
Nor how I feel or see
His Word is working mightily in me.

title: CHRIST’S WARRIORS
lyrics:
The King desires a drink of water,
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors)
Between His rejection and His
Power,
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors),
Noble Mighty men of valour,
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors)
Are cutting through to get a drink of water.

CHORUS

Mighty Gentile Warriors of the end-time, 2x
Valiant Mighty Gentiles of the end- time
Bringing a clean fresh drink for the
King.

Our foes are filled with fear and trembling,
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors)
As the Super-Church comes marching,
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors,)
They have heard how we overcame
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors)
Theologians and false anointed ones.

The Bride of Christ is marching over,
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors)
To the New Jerusalem,
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors)
Led by King Theophany
..............(Christ’s Mighty
Gentile Warriors)
To dwell with Him in His Holy
City.

title: BE STRONG IN THE LORD
lyrics:
CHORUS
Be strong in the Lord,
Be empowered,
Through your union with Him
Draw all your strength,
Put on the armour that God supplies,
That you, you may be able to stand.

We’re not wrestling with flesh and blood,
Contending with physical things,
But we’re standing in faith,
Against the rulers of this world;
Empowered by His spirit,
In the authority of His name.

Having shod your feet
With the Good News of peace,
Girding your loins with His truth,
The breastplate of righteousness
And the helmet of salvation;
The shield of faith and the sword of the Spirit.

Now standing complete in His image,
Refusing to be shaken from your place,
Praying at all times in the Spirit of the Lord,
Interceding on behalf of all the saints.

title: WE’VE COME THIS
lyrics:
We’ve come this far by faith,
Leaning on the Lord.
Trusting in His holy Word;
For now we have a perfect faith
Oh, Oh, Oh,
We can’t turn back,
We’ve come this far by faith.

Just remember the good things He has done,
Things that seemed so impossible,
We praise Him for the victories we have won!

title: ONE LOVE
lyrics:
CHORUS

One love, one love, one love, one love.

There was a time in the history of man
When he commanded the creation
And he and his Maker had one love;
And then the deceiver came,
And man lost the power of the
Name,
For he had broken the bond of one love;
It then took the blood of a spotless lamb
To be an atonement for fallen man
It was God’s substitute for his sin and shame ;
It was a part of God’s great mystery
To redeem you and me again,
Back to ................ chorus

Then one day the real Lamb came,
He came in the Father’s Name
To be a ransom for one love.
When on the cross my Saviour died,
The power of death He had defied,
To give us the token of one love.
He then changed our destiny,
He could now come and live in you and me,
Making us creatures now bound for eternity;
Brothers and sisters can’t you see,
He died to set you and I free again!
Back to ............. chorus

The Holy Ghost the Lord did send,
He fell upon some redeemed men,
They had the token and one love.
They baptized in Jesus Name;
And of His doctrine they weren’t ashamed,
For they were believers in one love.
But then as the ages rolled away
From this doctrine evil men did stray;
And the serpent began to ride this trail again.
Beware of the creeds of wicked men,
Designed to bring us back to bondage again;
But we want ....... chorus

In the end time the Son of man came,
He came in His Father’s Name
To give us the token of one love.
Seven Thunders sounded in our souls,
Our Lord had gathered us from this wicked world
To be united in one love;
Then we will speak and command creation again,
Sons and daughters in the
Father’s Name,
Having power and wrapped up in
His love;
The trumpet shall sound
And we’ll take our flight to the skies
To be in glory where we’ll be with our Father again,
Back to ..........chorus

title: WE’LL WALK IN THE LIGHT
lyrics:
We’ll walk in the Light,
We’ll walk in the Light,
We’ll walk in the Light,
Walk, in the Light of God.
Walk, walk, walk, in the Light,
Walk, walk, walk, in the Light,
Walk, walk, walk, in the Light,
Walk in the Light of God.

Famba Esibonakaleni,
Famba Esibonakaleni,
Famba Esibonakaleni,
Esibonakaleni kwe sikwembo,
Famba, famba, famba, famba,
Famba, famba, famba, famba,
Famba, famba, famba, famba,
Esibonakaleni kwe sikwembo.

title: BE IDENTIFIED
lyrics:
What does it profit a man to follow
The vain traditions of misguided men,
Who try to establish a righteousness of their own;
A propitiation for their sins?

BRIDGE

O tell me,
What do you think of the blood of
Jesus
That was shed for you?
Is it sufficient to pardon you from sin (Is it sufficient to purge your conscience from sin,)
(Is it sufficient to give you dominion over sin,)
Set you free, putting peace within?

CHORUS

Just be identified with your sacrifice
To be really justified, look to the place where Jesus died;
Be identified, really justified,
Look to the place where Jesus died.

What can a man do to be justified?
What does it take for an angry God to be pacified?
If you trust in your power, or struggle with all your might,
Yet your righteousness is like filthy rags in God’s sight.

What a work of grace that a man could clearly see
The Lamb with seven horns and seven eyes,
When darkness covers the earth and death begins to strike
In the place where the blood has not been applied!

BRIDGE

What do you think of the opening of those Seals,
God’s provided way for you?
Is it sufficient? Then, don’t add or take away;
It’s God's provided way to save you in this day.
What a work of power the blood has done for you and me,
Lifting us from a life of sin, turning our bodies heavenly.
And when Satan tries to convict you in the courts of memory,
Hear the Lamb return the verdict:
“Not guilty, not guilty!”
(“Not guilty, you are free!”)

title: BEULAH LAND
lyrics:
I’m kind of homesick for a country
To which I’ve never been before;
No sad good-byes would there be spoken,
And time wouldn’t matter any more.

CHORUS

Beulah Land, I’m longing for you!
And someday on thee I’ll stand,
There my home shall be eternal,
Beulah Land, sweet Beulah Land.

I’m looking now across that river
To where pain is going to end inside,
Now just a few more days to labour;
Then I shall take my heavenly flight.

title: Proverbs 3:9 HONOUR THE LORD
lyrics:
Honour the Lord
With all thy substance,
And the first fruits of all thine increase;
So shall thy barns be filled with plenty,
And thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

When you bring it
In the House of the Lord,
Bring it, in the House of the Lord,
And I will pour out my blessings upon you. 2x

title: COME WHAT MAY
lyrics:
He didn’t say that it was going to be easy;
Every promise my Lord has made
We’ve got to fight to claim.
For as many as He called,
He gave the power to overcome;
And every devil that stands before us
Must be on the run!
So why should I ever think it strange
When fiery trials should come my way?
For He said that if I do suffer for
His Name,
With Him I shall reign.

CHORUS

Come what may, with Your Word I will stay,
Come what may, I’ll press through anyway;
Come what may, Lord have Your way.

I’ll consider Him
Who for the joy that was set before
Him,
The cross He endured;
And that same life now dwelleth within me
Victory I’m assured.
For He did say, He’ll never leave me nor forsake me,
And as a seed of Abraham
I’ll possess the gates of my enemies!
Why should I ever think it strange
When fiery trials should come my way?
For He said that if I do suffer for
His Name
With Him I shall reign.

As I journey along,
May Lord I ever be, courageous and strong;
For inch by inch I’ll possess the land
For I’m a journeyman,
By striving lawfully,
Knowing Thou savourest reverence and humility;
Let the fullness of that meal offering
Be displayed in me!
I should never ever think it strange
When fiery trials should come my way,
For You said that if I do suffer for
Your Name,
With You I shall reign.

When I am down on the ground,
May I press through like a lily
In spite of the muck all around;
Rejoicing in the glory wherein You have clothed me.
When I am up in the air
And the strong winds blow,
May I ever know that You are there;
But if I be like a wounded dove,
May I press through with Your message of Love.
For I no longer ever think it strange
When fiery trials should come my way;
For I know that if I do suffer for
Your Name
Lord, with You I shall reign.

title: IT'S JUBILEE TIME  AGAIN
lyrics:
It's Jubilee time again,
The outpouring of the Latter rain,
When you hear the Trumpet,
Shout and worship Him.

Keep on rejoicing, rejoicing,
It's Jubilee time again,
Rejoicing, rejoicing,
The anointing breaks every chain

Keep on rejoicing, rejoicing.
You are pardoned from your sin,
Rejoicing, rejoicing,
The anointing breaks every chain

title: LET THE RAIN COME DOWN
lyrics:
We are living in these last days,
In a harassing and a thirsty age.
God sent Elijah His prophet again
That He might come and bring the rain.

CHORUS

Let the rain come down,
Let the thunder roll,
Filling me up, let me overflow
Till I can take no more;
Filling me up, let me overflow
Till I can take no more.

When you are a seed of God,
You’ve got to be planted in the
Word to die;
Your body might decay here in the earth,
But it will spring to life with eternal growth.

In these last days we are living in,
We know that the life which is in us will spring again,
As small as a mustard seed,
saints, it will grow;
As big and wide with branches flowing on the other side!

I want the former and the latter rain to reign in you;
I want the former and the latter rain to reign in me;
I want the former and the latter rain to reign in you;
I want the former and the latter rain to reign in me.

I want the rain to come and give me Faith,
I want the rain to come and give me Virtue,
Let the rain come and give me
Knowledge,
I want the rain to give me
Temperance,
Let the rain come and give me
Patience,
I want the rain to give me
Godliness,
Let the rain come and give me
Brotherly Kindness,
And Charity that the Super- anointing power could be seen in me.

Let the rain come down. (Repeat four times)

title: GOD IN SIMPLICITY
lyrics:
It’s God in simplicity,
Now revealed in humility,
King of Kings and Lord of Lords;
His name is called the Word of
God,
It’s God in simplicity.

The Seven Thunder mystery,
How He formed Himself in me;
Now I know I’m part of Him;
Soon He’ll come and take me home,
It’s God in simplicity.

Christ is the mystery,
Now revealed in you and me,
King of Kings and Lord of Lords;
His name is called the Word of
God;
Christ is the mystery.

title: JESUS  YOUR NAME
lyrics:
Jesus Your name is Power.
Jesus Your name is Might.
Jesus Your name will break every stronghold,
Jesus Your name is Life.

Jesus Your name is Healing.
Jesus Your name gives Sight.
Jesus Your name will free every captive,
Jesus Your name is Life.

Jesus Your name is Holy.
Jesus Your name is Light.
Jesus Your name is above every other,
Jesus Your name is Life.

title: SHE STEPS A LADY
lyrics:
She steps a lady all clothed in white,
Surrounded by a rainbow-colored light;
The sweetest smile she wears across her face,
As she beholds the One in whom she has found grace.

CHORUS

And what joy now fills her lover’s heart!
As He beholds His lovely Bride at last;
And with joy will the angels sing,
What adoration from the Seraphim!

Objections considered, all hollering will cease,
All other women will have to hold their peace;
He whispered to us in a language unknown,
And now the beauty of His Bride will be shown.

Oh, the mystery that the two have now become one,
And the victory of all ages is finally won;
Flesh of His flesh, bone of His bone, we are the same,
United we stand under that special name.

The Lamb takes His wife by the hand
And leads her unto the promised land,
Humble woman, He has chosen for His own,
Will sit with Him as Queen upon
His Throne.

title: GIVE ME MY MOUNTAIN
lyrics:
Give me my mountain, Amen,
Give me my mountain, Amen,
Give me my mountain;
The prophet had promised
Give me my mountain, Amen.

title: HIS MISSING RIB
lyrics:
It was some thousand years ago
In the beautiful garden of Eden;
When God made man and placed him
Over the earth to have dominion,
But He saw man was alone,
He had no one to share his home.

So God put man into a sleep
And took from his side,
One of his ribs close to his heart
With which He formed his bride.
His missing rib has been restored,
His missing rib was in bride form.

This bride has come all dressed in white,
A veil she has put on.
She’s come to stand at the side of him
Whom she was taken from.
His missing rib has been restored,
His missing rib is in bride form.

title: WE ARE  GOING OUT
lyrics:
A prophet like unto Moses came to us in this day,
Vindicated with signs and wonders,
He came to show us the way;
But now he’s left us, gone on to glory,
And God has Joshua on the scene;
So be thou strong and of good courage,
As He was with Moses,
So He’ll be with thee.

CHORUS

For we are the children going
Out of Egypt’s land,
We are the children marching
Into the promised land;
We are the children crossing over.
The Ark is going before us,
We are the children going out
In this Third Exodus.

Oh children, let’s all be ready,
Heed to all that God commands;
Let us obey all His instructions
To enter into the promised land
He is the captain of our salvation,
Defeated all our enemies.
Do not be fearful, just be courageous;
He is the leader as we march to victory.

title: THE ANCIENT OF DAYS
lyrics:
I beheld in the courts of Heaven
Where great treason was opposed:
Michael fought the great red Dragon
Who wanted to take control.
Kicked out of Heaven with the third of the stars,
Like lightning they fell to the earth,
They mingled the seed of men,
And by deceit, they gained control,
Until...

CHORUS

The Ancient of days did come,
With experience, maturity and wisdom;
The Ancient of days did come,
Restoring full dominion.
The Ancient of days did come
With experience, maturity and wisdom ,
The Ancient of days did come
And we must overcome.

MONOLOGUE

I beheld this same dragon on the earth was a dreadful beast:
He plundered and devoured,
having kings to bow at his feet.
But, I beheld till the Prince of
Princes came,
Great Michael, en morphe
As the bloody Lamb that was slain,
He brought to us the victory.
He is....

I beheld this beast was wounded
But his deadly wound was healed:
He cast down the truth, exalted a lie,
Having the whole world to be deceived.
I beheld till a Mighty Angel came
With an open book in His hand,
He gave me skill and wisdom to understand
God’s great mystery plan.

MONOLOGUE

I stood in the ranks of a great army,
They were the saints of the most high God;
We fought the dragon and overcame
By Michael’s two-edged sword.

title: TIRED UNDERPRIVILEGED
lyrics:
When I think about what God has done
Back there on Calvary;
Even Seven Angels coming in a
Cloud
Bringing back redemption for me
Opening up the Lamb’s book of
Life
And all the hidden mysteries,
And I know that we have eaten the Book,
What a people we should be!
And when I see another corn of wheat
Coming to a mature stage,
And this is the day of redemption
And the price has been paid;
Yet I see the things You’ve promised
Missing in my life,
Oh how I want to lose my life,
So your Life could be wrapped up in mine. 2x

CHORUS

For I’m tired living underprivileged
When I see what God has done;
I’m tired living as a servant
When it’s time for manifested sons.
Lord, You gave revival and
And you promised the Third Pull too;
For the greater works we have to do. 2x

There are souls under the altar,
They are crying out 'how long
Lord?'
Sleeping saints, they are anxiously
Awaiting on the resurrection.
In my heart there is a cry
To go back to that place,
No more darkly in a mirror
But seeing face to face.
The whole creation is groaning,
Waiting on that sweet release;
The lion wants to lay down with the lamb
For a thousand years of peace;
And I want to see the One
Who has been with us all the time;
But still I want to lose my life
So His Life could be wrapped up in mine. 2x

A new day has dawned
And I just can’t go on this way,
Just saying that I’m a Christian,
Walking with my Bible everyday,
The Prophet said the true church would write
Another Book of Acts,
And if I don’t come back to that place
Then I have missed the mark.
But between revivals the locks have grown,
There is a possibility;
The meal has been placed upon the sticks
To be baked into reality,
Faith to use the power
Is growing greater all the time.
So like Samson: Just once more
Lord,
Like Esther: If I perish I perish Lord,
Like Jonah: to do Your bidding Lord,
Like Joseph: to be a prisoner;
For the greater works we have to do. 2x

title: WE ARE  GOING OVER
lyrics:
We are going over Jordan.3x

And the ark is going before us.3x

And the waters now are parting.3x

title: SHE IS MY BRIDE
lyrics:
Come, see what I’ve found
In the dust of the ground;
A pearl of great price,
A jewel for my crown.
The gentle look in her eyes,
Motherhood she won’t despise,
Such a jewel is rare to find.
She’s like an Easter flower
That the Rock of ages did shelter;
Her beauty, her character is undefiled.

CHORUS

And she is my bride,
She is my virtuous wife;
She is my bride
Today and forever.

I’ve suffered much pain
Before I could take my claim,
But she was chosen long ago to bear my name.
We shared years of intimacy,
She was the great mystery in me;
She is flesh of my flesh
And bone of my bone.

MONOLOGUE

I believe, “blessed is the man who can find a virtuous wife,”
for we live in a time when the daughters of men are fair. But what is beauty without character anyway?... Just vanity..... So sons of God, turn your eyes away from that wild stare. Look for the virtues of sacred motherhood..... a meek and quiet spirit which is precious in the sight of the
Lord ...... And such virtues you can only find in the daughters of God ...... who, like Leah and
Rachel, will build the house of
Israel, raising sons and daughters of God.... would worship the Lord and bless
His Holy Name..... When you’ve found such a woman,
then you can truly say......

CHORUS

My love will keep her all the way,
At my side she’ll always stay,
For we’re united by my promises;
I’ll keep my word.
She’ll never be alone
Together we’ll share our future home,
My queen will sit with me upon my throne.

title: BEHOLD THE LAMB
lyrics:
About two thousand years ago
When John was on the earth,
Sent by God to pave the way
For the Saviour of this world:
And as he introduced the
Messiah
To the people there,
When he saw Jesus coming unto
Him,
This is what He said.

CHORUS

"Behold the Lamb
Who taketh away the sin of this world!"
Behold the Lamb
Has taken away, has taken away my sin.

Israel suffered serpent stings
When they provoked the Lord,
God’s mercy caused the brazen serpent
To be lifted up;
And as for healing, it was lifted
In the wilderness,
So Jesus Christ was lifted
So we could look and live.

In the beginning was the Word,
Then, taking fleshly form,
Was manifested through
Jesus Christ
And lifted on the cross:
And through the opening of those Seven Seals
We see so plain,
Just for our redemption, He’s lifted up again.

title: SAIL ON
lyrics:
Morning cometh and also the night,
Gross darkness upon the earth;
Many are wandering to and fro
And knowledge has increased.
But make sure your anchor holds my friend,
And keep your eyes upon the
North Star
’Cause He promised never to leave us;
He’s the author and the finisher.

CHORUS

Sail on, sail on, sail on, sail on,
Land ahoy!
Sail on, sail on, sail on, sail on.

A royal priesthood we are,
A peculiar people,
A holy generation
That comes from every nation.
And the captain of the Lord’s host is on our side,
With a flaming sword in His hand
To protect us as we go by.

We’ve been travelling six thousand years,
Going back to Eden.
Soon it wouldn’t be long,
We’ll soon see our Promised
Land.
Standing fast in the liberty
Wherein Christ has made us free,
Holding our confession to the end;
Lady Liberty.

We’re sailing through rugged,
jagged seas
With thunders, lightning and blasts;
Pressing through with all our might
To see God’s Word come to pass.
If we perish, we perish,
But we’re going to see our King,
Laying our lives on the line,
Knowing that we are nothing.

title: GOD’S EAGLES
lyrics:
I lived in a world of sin and shame
That only caused me grief and pain,
And I tried so hard to be free,
Searching for my true identity,
Didn’t know I came from eternity,
Until God came and revealed it to me.

CHORUS

On the wings of a snow-white Dove,
God sent His pure sweet love,
On the wings of a snow-white Dove
To take His eagle home. 2x

I knew somehow I was born to fly
Way up in the sky,
But somehow I couldn’t set my wings free;
But since that day I heard His voice
And made Him my heavenly choice,
By His grace I can say I’ve been set free.

Now behold what manner of love
The Father hath bestowed upon us,
That we might be called the Sons of God!
Wherever He bids us we will go,
Wherever He leads we will follow,
’Cause who the Son has set free is free indeed.

title: WE ARE HERE TO PRAISE
lyrics:
We are here to praise You,
To lift our hands and sing.
We are here to give You,
The best that we can bring;
Bringing You our love,
Rising from our hearts,
Everything within us cries,
“I love You Lord.”

title: VICTORY AND GLORY
lyrics:
I have heard but now I see,
God’s promise to you and me.
All these years through thick and thin,
We have laboured to enter in.
Then God’s silence was broken through and I can see me and you

CHORUS

Singing Victory,
Victory and Glory for all eternity,
It’s the promise of God to us.
Victory and Glory, for all eternity,
Hallelujah!
Victory and Glory, for all eternity,
We’ll sing it forever,
Victory and glory for all eternity.

The Thunders came, the Seals revealed,
Couldn’t understand all, but yet we believed.
Many thought we were off on a limb;
But they didn’t know we were worshipping Him.
Wednesday the third of June at
Cocoyea God decided to display
Himself.

Now we are climbing higher each day,
Conquering all devils who stand in our way,
This Bride is ready to make her stand
For the kingdom of God is at hand,
For it becometh unto us to fulfill all righteousness

This Bride’s revival is here to stay,
We must press harder to keep it that way.
Through prayer, obedience and sincerity,
We’ll all inherit eternity;
JVHU, I Jesus, is here to prove that this Bride won’t fail

title: OUR RESTORED FAITH
lyrics:
This Message bought us back to oneness with our God,
With Seven Seals opening up
His Holy Word.
Seven Mysteries thundering out and unfolding;
Rapturing Faith for Rapturing
Grace now revealing.

CHORUS

The Adoption, full Redemption,
All authority and power
Is restored unto the Bride in this great hour.

I was troubled and confused in
Laodicea,
No satisfaction for this deep and inward hunger,
Clouds of darkness hovered o’er me trying to blind me,
The Light broke through, the shadows flew, and now I can see.

I have heard about the inspired declaration,
Made by ambassadors for Christ from South in Trinidad,
The move is on for the chosen ones by election;
The local Bride is gathering in for the adoption.

Seven Voices thundered out in this hour,
Revealing Faith to Brotherly
Kindness for the Rapture,
Anointing hearts and lives with overcoming power;
Fear and bondage, skepticism could not linger.

We are quickened by this blessed revelation,
Changing from glory unto glory for Redemption,
Perfect Love uniting hearts for translation,
Perfect Faith conquering death for resurrection.

title: LET GOD HOLD YOUR HAND
lyrics:
When you feel that your life is almost gone,
And the burdens they are just too much to bear,
When you think that my God has left you in your most trying hour,
Just remember He’ll be there to hold your hand.

CHORUS

So just let God hold your hand,
He never failed and He will not fail,
He’ll always be there,
So when you think that you’re so alone,
My Jesus, He will help you stand,
So just let go and let God hold your hand.

Every word that He has promised is true,
He has kept me only by His saving grace,
So when the pressures of this world engulf you like a mighty sea,
He’ll be there, He will be there to hold your hand.

CHORUS

Take my hand precious Lord, lead me home.

title: JESUS NAME
lyrics:
Jesus, name above all names,
Wonderful Saviour,
Glorious Lord,
Immanuel, God is with us,
Blessed Redeemer, Living Word.

title: MY LORD DELIVERED ME
lyrics:
There was a time when
I was deep in sin,
No place in my heart
For the Lord to enter in;
Stumbling in darkness,
The way I could not find,
There was a deep in my soul,
I knew I was blind,
Until His light did shine.

CHORUS

My Lord delivered me with His mighty hand,
My Lord delivered me from the sinking sand.
My Lord delivered me, that is why I sing,
My Lord delivered me, I could never stop praising Him.

Now I am a warrior with a battle to fight,
I’m not afraid for the Lord my
Captain is in sight,
He’ll point the Silver Sword and
I’ll obey His Word,
But the foolish man, he can’t understand,
I’m His thought made flesh by predestination.

So here we are so great with child,
Resting on that Seventh Peak,
Waiting orders from on high
To exercise the Third Pull,
our inheritance;
But the wicked man cannot understand,
There cannot be any impersonation.

Love one another my brothers,
Let’s run this race,
Endure to the end,
For we know we’ll see His face.
Grow in grace my sisters,
Let’s fulfill all righteousness,
For we are flesh of His flesh and bone of His bone
We’ll sit with Him in His throne.

title: HOLDING MY PALM
lyrics:
When I see all Israel in their homeland,
When I see all prodigals come home;
Then, this evil world,
Clothed with darkness in their soul,
Very soon to hear from our Redeemer;
The Word-Bride, we are sealed and ready,
For the holy new Jerusalem;
I am rejoicing and singing, Shalom!
Holding my palm in my hand.

CHORUS

Yes, I am holding my palm in my hand, 2x
Where the eagles are gathered
Worshipping the Lamb,
I am holding my palm in my hand.

I’m not boasting about much revelation,
I’m not boasting about much inspiration;
But when I look in
And miss Elijah from the scene;
I believe and fear, for I know who is here;
About two hundred pounds
Of olive skinned complexion,
Pouring out His fullness unto man;
Like John, I shout, Hallelujah!
Holding my palm in my hand.

And when I hear God’s Holy Word revealing,
All the mysteries of Christ the Son of
Man;
I recognize my day and what the Spirit says,
“Come out of Laodicea;”
For the white horse rider will take the hindmost,
So come into the Royal Holy Ghost;
And the Spirit and the Bride say,
“Come, come, come,”
Holding my palm in my hand.

And when I feel that hot Shekinah glory,
Drawing me deeper into love’s veil;
And I feel those flames of light
Changing my robes to white,
To a place where I could never fail;
For it was by predestination,
He came to dwell in me, His chosen one;
Then let the winds, and the waves, and
Satan storm,
I am holding my palm in my hand.

Now when I see us gathered in Abel country
Reviewing forty years of history
And we see how we have come
All the battles that we have won
We are God's mighty marching army
Seven compound redemptive names of our great Jehovah
He has been revealing unto us
We are led by the Dove onto perfect love
And we are holding our palms in our hands

title: WE ARE YOUR PEOPLE
lyrics:
Oh Lord, we are Your people
Chosen by Your grace;
You took us from the heathen
To be a super race;
And as children of the great King of Kings
We have all reason to shout and sing;
You’ve given us joy, joy, joy.2x

If You should mark iniquity,
Which of us could stand?
How could we get through this life
Without Your guiding hand?
So Lord, we ask You, forgive our failures
And deliver us from all temptation;
And make us strong, strong,
strong.2x

We know we’re not deserving
Of all Your graciousness;
We know we fail You daily
And sometimes misbehave,
But Lord, we love You, we want to serve You,
Yes Lord, we need You and we believe You
Will help us overcome.2x

Oh yes, You have redeemed us
By Your precious blood;
Your power brought deliverance
When Satan came in like a flood;
And Lord we see You strong in battle,
Yes Lord, we see You breaking the shackles
And giving us Joy, Joy, Joy.2x

title: MORE THAN CONQUERORS
lyrics:
The hour of shaking is now at hand
When many builders would realize
They have built on sinking sand.
For the stone that the builders refused
They have rejected, the
Revelation of the Son of Man.
But unto you He's been a treasure,
And an anchor to your soul,
All the evils of this world
We’ll overcome.

CHORUS

For more than conquerors we are
Through the power of Jesus’ Name
Priests and Kings He has made us
And forever we shall reign

Many pressures came from outside and within,
And temptations did rise to take a look
Unto the other side;
But by the grace of God we resisted sin
And the devils were surprised,
We knew by the Word of the Lord
We were tested and tried;
But unto you who look above
Through the window of perfect love,
God has sent to us His sign
On the wings of a Dove.

Ministry becomes reality,
Now men will see with the eye
The works of God expressed through His little Bride,
Every knee must bow, every tongue confess,
Men’s folly be made manifest,
The foolish man won’t be able to stand;
But unto the wise who understands
Great exploits are now at hand,
For Michael’s feet are on the sea and on the land.

title: LO! IN HER MOUTH
lyrics:
We can see the signs of the times are all around,
Unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the Dragon’s mouth,
False prophets are lying and the truth they are denying;
But we have received our message of grace,
On the wings of a Snow-White dove.

CHORUS

Lo! in her mouth
Is an olive leaf,
That speaks about redemption,
That speaks about His grace.
Lo! in her mouth
Is an olive leaf;
It speaks about eternal life
And fellowship with God.

Economic and social pressures are everywhere,
Many have been caught unawares;
The hour of temptation has come upon everyone,
But unto us His little Bride, His voice whispers ‘Shalom!’

He said, "Fear not my child, all your troubles are over,
Your enemy has been destroyed.
Your great enemy has been conquered;"
Fear none of these things that shall tear this world apart,
For the Dove is cooing in our hearts
Who are shut up in the ark.

title: HE RECONCILED ME
lyrics:
He reconciled me from the pits of the miry clay,
He brought me in His arms to stay,
And I’ll praise Him for that day.
He reconciled me from the pits of the miry clay,
Whenever Satan comes my way,
I’ll remind Him of that day.

title: GREATER WORKS
lyrics:
CHORUS

Greater works than these shall you do,
For it’s a promise for me and you.
Greater works than these shall you do,
For it’s a promise for me and you.

For we are partakers, Lord, of
Your holiness,
And we are now clothed in Your righteousness;
And we are Your children walking in this Evening Light,
And in Your Bride You’ll be glorified.

For the God of Peace shall bruise
Satan under our feet,
The army of the living God, he shall not defeat;
So let us praise God for this mighty privilege
To be a part of this apostolic heritage.

For the cup of the iniquity of this world is almost full,
And here we are upon Mt. Zion awaiting that final pull;
May God grant us the faith to use that two-edged sword,
For every day Your elect cries,
“Just once more Lord.”

So brothers and sisters let’s keep on abiding in His Word;
Don’t look to the things of this world and get your vision blurred;
For we’ve been drawn to that holy place
Where Our Lord has placed His name;
Having blessed assurance He’ll glorify it again.

Greater works than these shall you do,
For it’s a promise for me and you.

BRIDGE

Unconditional promise for me and you,
Unfailing promise for me and you,
Holy Ghost promise for me and you,
Seven Thunders promise for me and you,
Oh, what a mighty promise for me and you.

title: VESSELS OF HONOUR
lyrics:
We are troubled on every side
Yet not distressed,
Perplexed but not in despair;
Persecuted but not forsaken,
Even in trials we are not forgotten.

That’s why in all these things,
We are more than conquerors
Pressing the upward way;
And we bear in our bodies
The dying of our Lord everyday,
everyday.

CHORUS

’Cause we are vessels of honour
Set aside unto the Master’s use,
And they whom He foreknew,
Them He did choose.
2x

Our Lord was tempted on every side,
Yet without sin,
That we could reign with Him;
Proven to be the true Saviour,
Lord and King and Blessed
Redeemer.

Now we are given a sacred trust
To fulfill His word
In this hour of destruction.
Surely goodness and mercy
Will be with us despite the condition.

title: GOD’S ELECTIVE LOVE
lyrics:
Deep calleth unto deep ,
In the night time I scarcely sleep.
Why art thou disquieted in me my soul?

I’ve found hope in the Lord of glory;
He has revealed my life’s mystery,
Shown me that I was in His thoughts from times of old.

CHORUS

It’s the rising of the sun,
When the children of God on the earth are born;
This Evening Light from above,
It’s nothing less than God’s elective love.

I see Mary, she’s walking slowly,
Along the narrow road that’s dusty,
When the child is born your sorrow will be gone;
“Esther, Esther, touch that sceptre,
With the King you have found favour;”
Anything you do, do it in that name.

Samson’s locks are now a little longer,
Faith muscles are becoming stronger,
Between the pillars the Lord will strike His Masterpiece;
Now the Headstone is drawing nearer,
Dynamics are worked in greater measure;
Pulsations of faith will soon create: “Let there be.”

Seven Thunders activating the countdown,
The North Star leads the battle stars to the showdown,
Two hundred million devils will be on the run;
Joel’s mighty army comes on display,
The elements will tremble before them on that day,
For strong is the Lord that executeth His Word.

Our hearts are burning with expectation,
For the promised eternal vacation,
Reservations have already been made;
Next attraction, coming soon,
Bridegroom and Bride leave for honeymoon,
On the wings of Love she’ll take her flight thru’ the skies.

title: AFTER ALL
lyrics:
Trials here are sometimes many,
